scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: I wish I could make some clothing for my grandchildren for the festival season...

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: Oh! Would you give me your ^3355FFSkirt of Virgin^000000? I'd need four of them. Please, I'm begging you.
Alright.
No way!

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: Oh! Thank you so much~ Now I can make some clothes for Kitty Cutty~

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: Ah, Wait! I almost forgot. I was quite a popular actress back in my youth. My actor friends gave me a wedding present when I left the Troupe. I've kept it to remind me of those precious times.

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text:
If it's okay...
I'd like to give you this.

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text:
Goodbye, adventurer~!
Thank you for making an old woman so happy...

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: *Sigh* How can I get ^3355FFSkirt of Virgin^000000 by myself? I'm just so weak and feeble, even rolling in my rocking chair exhausts me. *Sniff* All I want is to make my grandchildren happy...

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: I gather Mushrooms on the Mountain of Payon everyday. Time passes and before I know it, it's already fesitval season. I wish I could make clothing for my family this time of the year.

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text:
...
But for that, I need ^3355FF4 Skirt of Virgin^000000...

scripts.speaker: Granny
scripts.text: Young traveler, please help me. When you find some ^3355FFSkirt of Virgin^000000, please bring them to me. I'd really appreciate it...

scripts.speaker: Mystic Lady
scripts.text: My family has produced and sold the special Winter product ^3355FFEar Muffs^000000 for many years. We just moved here, but the weather is always warm so we can hardly make a living.

scripts.speaker: Mystic Lady
scripts.text: If you plan to travel to colder regions, I suggest that you bring some ^3355FFEar Muffs^000000...

scripts.speaker: Mystic Lady
scripts.text: Ear Muffs are my family's specialty, and we provide it to customers who have ^FF33551 Cursed Ruby^000000, ^3311AA1 Headset,^000000 ^3355FF 200 Feathers^000000 and ^DDDD005000 Zeny^000000.
Oh Yeah? That sounds good.
No thank you, Ma'am.

scripts.speaker: Mystic Lady
scripts.text: Here, I will give you this pre-made one.

scripts.speaker: Mystic Lady
scripts.text: Thank you for buying our product. You won't regret purchasing our Ear Muffs: Satisfaction guaranteed~

scripts.speaker: Mystic Lady
scripts.text:
Oh dear...
You don't have enough money or items. Unfortunately, we can't give any discounts. Please understand that we have to make a living...

scripts.speaker: Mystic Lady
scripts.text:
That's fine.
I believe we
will meet again.
...One of these days.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
ArrrGggghh!
Ah, No I can't...

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
*Huk*
Now even my eyes have gone mad!! Why do these bugs suddenly seem so cute?! Nooooooo~!!!
Show Ora Ora
Give Ora Ora
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
Oooooohhhh!!!
Is, is this
the one?!
This is...
Ora Ora!!

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: I'll make it short! Give it to me, and I will give you my treasure! So how's my idea? Wanna deal?

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
Muhahahahah!!!
I finally have this!
Ora Ora!
Stupid and Disgusting
Thief Bugs!!
You will pay!!!

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
Huk...Huk...
Sorry, I was out of control with pleasure for a while. Now, I will give my treasure as promised.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: When you wear this over your mouth and start to breathe, it filters junk out before getting to your lungs.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
Kakakakakaka!
I can't wait
to use this
Ora Ora!

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
Huhuhuhuhu...
What if I can't get rid of all these Thief Bugs? I might even grow to love them... *Huk*

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
Wahhhhhh! I, I...
I can't take it any more!
You little stinky filthy bastards!
Continue
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
Oh man...
It all started when my parents passed away when I was a little kid. Early on I had to work for a living, and had a really hard time.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: I've worked for 10 years in hopes of buying my dream house where I could find some sense of peace and comfort again. Eventually I thought I had enough zeny to afford my very own sweet home.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: Unfortunately I didn't have enough money to buy the nice house that I had my eye on. But then, I found this house, which was bigger and cheaper than the first. I bought it without thinking...

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: Sweet Jesus! Turns out, it's a Heaven for Thief Bugs!!!

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: I tried to do everything I could do. I coaxed them, killed them, but it only brought peace for a moment! I even tried to burn this house down...!

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: *Gasp* I mean, really, do I need ^3355FF Ora Ora^000000 to get rid of them? People say it is very rarely seen in distant countries.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: If I could afford 5 of them, I won't have to be frustrated with these disgusting bugs any more...

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text: This never ending fight with the bugs has really exhausted me. I give up. Do as you wish you scumbags!

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text: ...What is it?
Can you make me a special item?
Hey.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text: Huh? So you already know what I specialize in, eh? I suppose there's no need for the usual secrecy. Tell me what you want.
Helm of Angel.
Deviruchi Cap.
I will come next time.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text:
1 Helm (with slot).
1 Angel Wing.
5 Fang of Garm.
That's all I require.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text: Wait! Just so you know, I don't care if the items in your inventory have been upgraded, or have cards attached.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text: I mean, any cards or upgrades in the items I will use to make something for you will be lost once I make the item. So be careful when you hand stuff over to me.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text: Did you gather the items? Then hand them over.
Give him the items.
Don't give him the items.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text:
.....Hm.
Fine, here's your Helm of Angel. Take it.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text: ...The number of items is not right. You better double check.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text: Do as you wish...

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text:
600 Little Evil Horn.
40 Talon of Griffon.
That's all I require.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text: Wait! Just so you know, I don't care if the items in your inventory have been upgraded, or have cards attached.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text: I mean, any cards or upgrades in the items I will use to make something for you will be lost once I make the item. So be careful when you hand stuff over to me.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text: Did you gather the items? Then hand them over.
Give him the items.
Don't give him the items.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text: .....Hm. Here's your Deviruchi Hat. Please take it.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text: ...The number of items isn't right. You better double check.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text: Do as you wish...

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text:
Hm. Alright.
Then we shall meet again.

scripts.speaker: Young man
scripts.text:
Hm.
Take care.
